name: Finkle Einhorn, At Your Service!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 57 instead of 55. Gives 6,600 experience instead of 7,050, 0.94 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You'll find Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook, champion. Tell him that 'Finkle is A-OK' and that the suit works perfectly.

Then hand him this:

<Finkle hands you a glowing piece of flesh.>

I snatched it from the beast's innards during my 'vacation.'

I bet Malyfous could give you a fairly accurate assessment of what he can do with parts from a monster like this!

Oh, I suppose you don't know where Everlook is, do you? To Winterspring, <fella/lady>!
narrative.objectives: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
narrative.offerRewardText: Alive? Suit worked? And what do we have here?
